entries.title: See valid stock actions
entries.description: Inventory controls now consistently show which actions each Part can take, with clearer validation for fabricated, linear, and Built Parts.

entries.title: Review stock warnings before posting
entries.description: Movement dialogs now warn consistently about unusual quantities, including returns for specific purchase lines and length buckets.

entries.title: Track purchasing at a glance
entries.description: Inventory now shows quantities on order, Purchase Orders flag returns awaiting credit, and unpriced drafts are labelled clearly instead of appearing free.

entries.title: Book only unfinished unscheduled jobs
entries.description: Completed Jobs no longer appear in the Unscheduled Book Slot list, while remaining available through the All filter.

entries.title: Remove abandoned units
entries.description: Administrators can permanently remove a Product Unit that was never built after its Jobs have been cancelled.

entries.title: Export on-hand unit values
entries.description: Download a priced CSV of On Hand units with material cost, list price, serial, build, customer, Quote, and Invoice details.

entries.title: Cancel work cleanly
entries.description: Cancel Jobs with a recorded reason, release upcoming bay slots and stock commitments, and optionally clean up linked Jobs or unbuilt units when cancelling Quotes and Stock Builds.

entries.title: Recognise offerings at a glance
entries.description: Custom work and Product builds now use consistent colours, icons, and Product photos across Quotes, Jobs, the Board, and activity.

entries.title: Scan the Board by department
entries.description: Production bays are now grouped and ordered by department on the Gantt Board.

entries.title: Fit more into quote PDFs
entries.description: Quote documents use a more compact header, customer summary, and pricing table for cleaner pagination and fewer pages.

entries.title: Complete enquiries faster on mobile
entries.description: The contact form now supports phone autofill and appropriate mobile keyboards, with a corrected Afrikaans email placeholder.

entries.title: Confirm stock warnings before posting
entries.description: The Stores tablet now previews unusual checkouts, returns, and receipts before posting, using accurate purchase-line and length-bucket quantities.

entries.title: Use only valid stock actions
entries.description: Receive, supplier-return, build, and other stock controls now follow the same Part rules as the web app and show more accurate explanations when unavailable.

entries.title: Recognise offerings at a glance
entries.description: Custom work and Product builds now use consistent colours, icons, and Product photos across Job, Quote, and bay views.

entries.title: Cancel quotes reliably
entries.description: Quote cancellation now reliably cancels the linked Job and remaining schedule, while clearly explaining that any unbuilt machine must be removed from the web app.
